Name: MultiplayerBackpacks
Author: skiilaa
Description:
[center]This mod lets you see other farmers' inventories/backpacks in multiplayer mode.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Right-click on any farmer in multiplayer to view their inventory.
You can exit from the view with the Escape key.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 beta on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[/list][/center]
